summary: Starter release notes record for governed customer upgrades. Use this file to link change summary, diagnostics and known issues to repeatable upgrade checks.

notes.title: Upgrade discipline baseline
change_summary: Release metadata and startup bundle remain version-linked.
Upgrade path requires support bundle, backup preview, restore drill and post-upgrade smoke.
Customer upgrade reports remain diagnostics-first and do not imply rollout safety without evidence.
known_issues: Legacy web_cabinet import warnings may still appear in dev/test logs.
Operational rollout and competitive acceptance diagnostics may be absent in fresh environments until their gates are run.
upgrade_notes: Run support bundle and pre-upgrade backup before touching the customer environment.
Use restore drill proof as rollback-readiness evidence.
Use release package smoke to confirm packaged build integrity.
